tbesh_html:
Beeshterah = "with increase"
a Levitical city in Manasseh, east of the Jordan; probably identical with 'Ashtaroth'
Another name of ash.ta.rot (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת "Ashtaroth" H6252H)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan
strongs_1890.derivation: from H6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה) (as singular of H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת)) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth;
